> Paste `https://www.figma.com` **with a trailing slash removed or added** (e.g. `https://figma.com`), and also try the insecure `http://figma.com`. In each case it should recognize it as the **same** Figma bookmark you already have — opening it for editing rather than making a copy — and keep the secure `https` address.

While you try that, let me also confirm two situations I'd handle **in text** (no visual difference):

- **A saved page's title changes later on the web:** the app keeps *your* saved title/description/note as they were — it doesn't silently overwrite what you've edited. If you ever want the latest, that would be a deliberate "refresh" action (which I'd note as a possible future addition, not part of this build). Agree?
- **Ordering:** newest saved appears at the top of each list. Agree that's the default you'd want?

Tell me if the near-duplicate behaves right and whether those two are fine — then I think we've covered the ground and I can summarize the whole scope for your go-ahead.
